_about: Every gate number of the strategy pipeline (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-strategy-pipeline-design.md; `bp.py pipe`), read by blueprint/pipe_rules.py: need(*keys). Shares and odds are fractions. `card` = what a pipeline card may hold (ways, values a way, indicators, bar sizes, markets, sessions: the evening session too, since 2026-10-09). `raw` = the raw heat map of stage 1: `strict` is the law's own bar (lines 2.1, 2.2, 2.4), `low` the wider door (a smaller share and half the floor, held to more trades); `floor_part` = the part of line 2.2's cost floor the average trade must reach. `indicator` = stage 3 (`other_markets` = the share of the other markets that must agree). `proof` = stage 4: `reshuffle` is line 2.8's share of the runs; `random_alpha` makes the random bar, 1 - alpha / tries, the law's ladder of line 2.3 carried on past round 5. `box` = the best days taken out at the lock and on the test (lines 3.8, 4.6), and two numbers of the book card: `fast_seconds` (a trade held that long or less is a fast trade: its share of the profit is on the card) and `month_days` (the session days of a month: winning days a month). `prop` = the 30-day prop odds of one strategy on `account`, and `book_accounts`: the rule files of the app's prop simulator whose odds a book card shows; `portfolio` = the bar a portfolio is built to (stage 8, blueprint/pipe_portfolio.py: `eval` and `payout` = the odds a mix must reach within those days), and three things the design says that no other file carries, added 2026-10-09 when stage 8 was built: `fast_share` (at most this share of a mix's profit may come from trades held box.fast_seconds or less: the design's "at most half"), `one_side` (the accounts where orders may rest on ONE side only, the design's section 13: a strategy whose entry rule rests orders on both sides cannot go in a mix there) and `funded_only` (the accounts that have no eval to pass, section 13: their mixes are judged on the payout odds alone). The rule files of those accounts do not say so themselves. `test` = stage 6, the read of the unseen days: `one_read_a_slot` false = every pipeline idea gets its own read of the unseen days (the owner, 2026-10-08); true = the toolkit's rule: one read a family, market and session (an idea run by hand through `bp.py test` is always held to that rule; an idea's own read is one read either way). A number the law also carries (raw.strict.share = 2.1, raw.strict.trades = 2.4, proof.reshuffle = 2.8, the random bar = 2.3 to 3 decimals, box.best_days_share = 3.8 and 4.6) must be the same here and in rules.json: pipe_rules.py refuses to load when they differ. A change here is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py. `mode` = "variant" (shipped 2026-10-08, the owner: the map gets a LOOSE check and one box is picked right after it; the hard rules are judged on THAT ONE box) or "map" (the old behaviour: the whole 144-box map is judged by `raw`, `indicator` and `proof`). `variant` = the numbers of variant mode: `map_share` (stage 1: over this share of the boxes must make money), `region_boxes` and `region_trades` (at least this many boxes must be at the floor with at least this many trades; the pick is made among them; the picked box must also have that many trades), `floor_part` (the part of line 2.2's cost floor the picked box's average trade must reach), `pick_boxes` (the owner, 2026-10-09: the pick is made among the boxes at the floor that hold EVERY line a box is held to on the build days -- stage 3's rows and the lock's lines 3.3-3.8 -- and at least this many must; of them the middle one by the odds to pass the eval on prop.account is picked, never the best; the map with the most such boxes moves on), `box_tries` (the owner, 2026-10-09: "i want to make it so we dont have to worry about missing a strategy under our nose" -- when the picked box does not hold at the proof (stage 4) or cannot be locked (stage 5: worse fills), the NEXT box that holds every line is tried, from the middle outward by prop odds and then the other maps' boxes, at most this many boxes an idea: the blueprint's 5 rounds; every box tried is one more try of the random bar, 1 - alpha / tries). Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py. `gates` (2026-10-10, the owner) = which lines ASK: see gates._about. `prop.eval` is 40 % since 2026-10-10 (it was 50 %): the bar of the eval-odds gate and of the label "stands alone"; `prop.fees` = the eval fee in dollars an account costs (the owner, 2026-09-30: $140 without the daily limit, $115 with it), read by the book card's fee line.

gates._about: THE GATES (the owner, 2026-10-10, after the Matteo Conti interview on prop firms: "go off what he says"). mode "law" = every line of the blueprint asks (the pipeline as it was 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-10); mode "prop" = ONLY THREE THINGS ASK: (1) the picked box makes money on the build days after costs (an average trade above $0, with `variant.region_trades` trades: a box with too few trades has no average) -- rows P3.2 and P3.3; (2) its eval odds on prop.account, the PLAIN row, open losses counted, within prop.days, are prop.eval or more -- the owner's 40 %; (3) the picked box still makes money on the unseen days (its own net above $0). Every other line of the law and of the pipeline is still READ and printed, as a LABEL (passed null, `held` = what it would have said, `label` = PASS / MISS): the share of boxes profitable, the sides, the other markets, the steadiness rows P3.7-P3.10, the lock's 3.3-3.8, the proof of stage 4 (reshuffle, random entries), the worse fills, lines 4.1-4.9. The code check (1.1-1.4) and the price check (P2.5) stay hard: they say the code is right, not that the idea is good. The line of the account is untouched: LucidPro 50K, drawdown read with OPEN LOSSES counted (the owner: "its EOD but it still counts open losses"). `variant` = the numbers of variant mode that mode "prop" puts over the file's own `variant` block (a floor of $0, one box at the floor is enough, one box that holds the gates is enough; the share of boxes profitable keeps its 50 % and is a label). A change here is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py and tests/test_pipe_prop_gates.py.

winlane._about: THE WIN-RATE LANE (the owner, 2026-10-12: "most important is the win rate ... a really monthly consistent winrate"). mode "off" = nothing changes; "label" (shipped 2026-10-12) = rows P3.11 and P3.12 are READ and printed on every box as labels, asking nothing: look first, decide after; "ask" = the same two rows ask, and a box that misses either cannot be the picked box. In "label" and "ask" the eval odds of gates.mode "prop" are SHOWN, not asked (the owner, 2026-10-12: the win rate comes first). P3.11: the box's win rate (trades with a net above $0 after costs, over all its trades) is `win_rate` or more. P3.12: of the months with `month_trades` trades or more, `months` of them have a win rate of `month_floor` or more. A change of a number or of the mode is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_winlane.py.
